stories.title: Merz cancels UN General Debate trip — “presence required in Berlin”

facts.text: Gov’t circles to ARD: Chancellor Friedrich Merz will not travel to New York next week “entgegen ursprünglicher Planungen,” because his presence is required in Berlin (tagesschau ~20:42).
He had been booked to address the UN General Debate Wednesday afternoon local time; Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul (CDU) is again expected to speak for Germany (tagesschau).
Context: CDU’s Saxony-Anhalt rout (17.2%); Sunday votes in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Berlin; CDU Präsidium/Fraktion meetings Mon–Tue (tagesschau/DLF).
DLF: Merz also called a CDU Präsidium session for Sunday evening after the polls; he reiterated yesterday he will serve the full term and keep the SPD coalition (DLF).

stories.whyItMatters: Clearest signal yet that domestic party pressure after Saxony-Anhalt now overrides Merz’s “Außenkanzler” calendar ahead of two more state tests.

stories.title: Saudi coalition intercepts Houthi drone near Mecca; Yanbu oil loadings paused

facts.text: Coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki: Royal Saudi Air Defence intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone Tuesday evening before it entered restricted airspace near Mecca (Al Jazeera/Reuters).
Mecca civil-defence alert activated for the first time since a 2017 Houthi attempt, then lifted within minutes; similar alerts in Taif and Jeddah (Al Jazeera).
Houthis deny any threat to Mecca or holy sites via SABA; coalition vows a “firm” response after urban strikes in Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif injured 13 (Al Jazeera).
Separately: oil loadings at Red Sea terminal Yanbu suspended after East-West pipeline attacks; terminal had been ~4 mb/d before the halt (Maritime Executive / Reuters).

stories.whyItMatters: Holy-city scare plus a Red Sea export choke point tightens the Middle East energy/security loop already lifting crude.

image.alt: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi drone headed for Mecca

stories.title: Cabinet to weigh 10-point plan after Berlin CSD Islamist attack

facts.text: dpa/SZ: Cabinet on Wednesday to discuss a 10-point package (Dobrindt/Hubig) after the 25 July CSD vehicle attack in Berlin Tiergarten (1 killed, ≥31 injured).

Includes a one-year minimum prison term for especially dangerous knife/tool assaults that endanger life or risk serious injury; probation decisions from ≥6 months must weigh public-security interest (SZ).
Länder investigators (not only BKA/Bundespolizei) could order time-limited telecom Verkehrsdaten retention when there are crime indicators or an existing danger — if state police law allows (SZ).
Attacker Abdul B. was known to authorities as a radical Islamist; May 2026 Jugendstrafe of 1y10m with Vorbewährung for IS prep/propaganda preceded the July attack (SZ).

stories.whyItMatters: First concrete federal criminal-law response package after the CSD attack — expands knife sentencing and traffic-data powers.

stories.title: OpenAI says it’s talking AI safety standards with Anthropic and Google

facts.text: OpenAI spokesperson to CNBC (Tue): company has been engaging Anthropic and Google on how to work together on safety; talks ongoing since Demis Hassabis’s July call for a U.S.-led “Standards Body” (FINRA-style).
Follows Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s Saturday essay urging slower frontier-model advances — praised by Hassabis and Sam Altman (CNBC).
Altman: pacing advanced models has been a “primary topic” at OpenAI lately; more to share “soon” (CNBC).
OpenAI’s Chris Lehane earlier this month: industry-led standards would complement — not replace — mandatory federal safeguards (CNBC).

stories.whyItMatters: Material update beyond last night’s kill-switch chatter: the three frontier labs confirm competitive rivals are at least talking shared standards.

stories.title: Pistorius and Hegseth sign closer US–Germany arms cooperation MoU

facts.text: BMVg after Pentagon visit: Defence Minister Boris Pistorius (SPD) and US counterpart Pete Hegseth signed an agreement to meet more NATO weapons/ammo/equipment demand from German production (DLF).
Hegseth praised German defence-spending progress toward the 5% NATO target and stronger European NATO capacity; Pistorius called the talks good (DLF).
Tomahawk delivery details for Germany still to be clarified; Thursday in Texas Pistorius is due to take delivery of the first ordered F-35 for the Bundeswehr at Lockheed Martin (DLF).
~38,000 US troops make Germany the largest US footprint in Europe; Trump has floated cutting ~5,000 — no timeline yet, per Pistorius (DLF).

stories.whyItMatters: Concrete industrial MoU plus F-35 handover week — Berlin leaning harder into US kit even as troop-cut talk lingers.

image.alt: Boris Pistorius und Pete Hegseth stehen vor einer offenen Tür.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking

facts.text: Google (15 Sep): Gemini 3.8 Live for fluid real-time voice + visual grounding; 3.8 Live Extended Thinking for multi-step reasoning with live progress narration while tools run in the background.
Extended Thinking claims #1 on Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Quality Index (82.6) and leads agentic voice benches τ-Voice 68.6% / Sierra τ-Voice-banking 35.1% (Google).
Rollout: Gemini API + AI Studio; Search Live / Gemini Live; Workspace Docs Live, Gmail Live, Keep Live for subscribers; enterprise private preview (Google).
All generated audio watermarked with SynthID (Google).

stories.whyItMatters: Google’s bid to make voice agents production-grade — shipping the models into Search, Gemini app, and Workspace Live surfaces the same day.
